CONCEPT REFERENCE ONLY (art direction study, not a game asset). A gameplay-style screenshot mood study for a modern 2D pixel-art roguelike action game, same world, same steep three-quarter top-down camera and same modern high-detail pixel-art style as the attached image (crisp pixels, rich mid-tones, painterly light), but a completely different location - do not reuse the attached composition. Camera: orthographic, the floor is seen from above on a square grid; every wall, building and large structure shows its tall FRONT face (about two tiles high) so characters can walk behind them. Scale: the screen shows about 30 by 17 floor tiles and a character is about one and a half tiles tall. The middle of the screen is an open, calm, low-contrast floor that stays readable for combat; height, props and light sources sit around the edges.

Scene: an outdoor yard in the brewery and distillery district of the liquor empire, at night. The north edge is a soot-blackened brick distillery building whose tall front face has two big arched furnace mouths glowing amber, iron doors, and pipes and valves running along it; behind and above it rise two huge dark iron pot stills with copper-capped domes and swan-neck pipes, seen from above. A stone canal of glowing amber liquor crosses the arena horizontally near the south side, with low stone banks whose tops are visible and two short wooden plank bridges over it; the liquor surface is the main warm light of the scene. The rest of the floor is wet, worn flagstones with dark liquor stains, calm and readable. West and east edges hold pyramids of big oak casks, a wooden gantry crane with a barrel hanging on a chain, coiled ropes, iron vats, a steam vent with drifting vapor, wooden pallets and a hand cart.

Lighting: dark smoky blue-gray night, deep shadows, slight vignette. Strong warm amber from the furnace mouths and the glowing canal, steam lit amber from below, bright specular glints on wet stones, barrel hoops and pipe edges facing the light, soft falloff into darkness at the corners. One small dark-coated figure with a wide-brimmed hat stands in the open middle; two hunched brewery porters push barrels nearby.

Palette: charcoal and cool slate grays with subtle blue-gray in the shadows, warm umber wood, dirty pale plaster or stone, and a single warm amber/ember accent for every light source. No saturated blue, green, purple or red. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no HUD, no watermark, no frame.
